ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Самоотречение» (samootrechenie) is 'self-renunciation' and «отречение» (otrechenie) 'renunciation', kept distinct from «самоотвержение» (samootverzhenie, 'self-denial'); «личность» (lichnost') is 'personality' and «благо» (blago) 'the good'. Attributions follow the print («Карлейль», Karleyl', 'Carlyle', not expanded as in the website draft; «Браминская мудрость», 'Brahmanic wisdom').
